Vulnerabilities.Title: Flask vulnerable to possible disclosure of permanent session cookie
Vulnerabilities.Description: Flask is a lightweight WSGI web application framework. When all of the following conditions are met, a response containing data intended for one client may be cached and subsequently sent by the proxy to other clients.

Misconfigurations.Title: Image user should not be root
Misconfigurations.Description: Running containers with 'root' user can lead to a container escape situation.
Misconfigurations.Message: Specify at least 1 USER command in Dockerfile with non-root user as argument
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add a USER command to the Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: No healthcheck defined
Misconfigurations.Description: You should add a HEALTHCHECK instruction to the Docker image to ensure that health checks are executed against the running container.
Misconfigurations.Message: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction to the Docker image
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction to the Dockerfile
